Synopsis:
Default dialog of Marcus, the tadpoled Flaming Fist spy tasked by Ketheric with abducting Isobel. Marcus is outside Isobel's room when this dialog plays and he tries to convince the player to join him in kidnapping isobel. Can lead to combat or alliance.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_TakingIsobel_FlamingSpy.json: Marcus is a Flaming Fist spy standing outside Isobel’s room/balcony, sent (or compelled) to seize the Selûnite cleric alive and deliver her to Ketheric/General Thorm. He may pretend familiarity to smooth things (claiming to have vouched for you) and tries to recruit the player to help abduct Isobel, warning that failure will draw the General’s wrath. If the player has relevant flags they can probe Marcus’s mind and learn he’s acting on orders and/or under the Absolute’s influence; the exchange can then branch into cooperation or immediate hostilities. In the combat variant ghouls are summoned, Mol can be abducted, and any Flaming Fists present may be knocked out or incapacitated.
- HAV_TakingIsobel_SpyCapture.json: Marcus Falgor is a Flaming Fist agent who bursts into Isobel’s chamber on a balcony where she’s been performing a Selûne ritual, intent on seizing her and taking her “alive” to Ketheric. Depending on how the scene begins, this follows a prior briefing in the room (giving the player the choice to side with Isobel or Marcus) or it erupts into combat when Marcus is already hostile; in the combat variant Marcus defaults to aggression. The player—who can use the tadpole mind‑meld to probe thoughts—may learn Marcus is acting under specific orders to deliver Isobel alive or that he’s mentally enslaved by the Absolute; either outcome affects dialogue and choices. Off‑screen, ghouls are summoned during the abduction, Mol is taken, and any available Flaming Fists may be incapacitated during the scuffle.
- HAV_TakingIsobel_FollowUpSaved.json: Jaheira and Isobel (and the player) reunite after the fight with Marcus. Jaheira is relieved Isobel hasn't been captured. Isobel debriefs with player and sends them off on their main mission for Act 2. Both of them will be in heightened mood, having just survived a fierce battle- not totally out of breath, but still recovering from the immediate battle.
- MOO_ZrellBriefing_FlamingSpy.json: Marcus is in Moonrise after either kidnapping isobel OR being thwarted by the player.
- CAMP_Isobel.json: Isobel is hanging out in MOO after the defeat of Ketheric. If NS is alive, this dialogue will follow their reunion. She is glad Ketheric is dead and does exposition about her story with her father/ Nightsong. At the end she may join your camp.
